title: Mandyium
description: Adds Mandyium Ore,Mandyium ingot,Mandyium Tools and a Mandyium Dimension.
body:
Mandyium Mod Adds a brand new ore called Mandyium — super rare, stronger than netherite, and used to make some powerful gear. You’ll need Bundled Sticks to craft anything Mandyium-related, which are made with 8 sticks around a log .

🧱 What’s in the mod:
Mandyium Ore – Spawns deep underground and drops Mandyium Ingots. Tough to find, worth the grind.

Bundled Sticks – Crafting ingredient for all Mandyium tools and weapons.

Full Set of Tools & Weapons – Stronger than netherite, balanced to not be too OP.

Mandyium Block – Used to build the portal.

New Dimension – Light the portal with the Mandyium Dimension Igniter and step into a new world.

Everything’s survival-friendly and meant to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft.
